summary: Quality Industrial Corp. filed an 8-K regarding a Forbearance Agreement with RB Capital Partners on July 10, 2026, modifying convertible promissory notes originally totaling $1.3M. Outstanding amount of $1,587,439.64 restructured into a $1,675,000 Payment Amount payable in 19 monthly installments ($25K to $175K) through January 2028, with a $30K discount for timely payments, 7% interest ceased. The notes allowed conversion at $1.00/share. No board recommendation or advisor named. Mechanics include prepayment without penalty. Watch for payment defaults; risk hinges on cash flow sufficiency.
